svg.title: Warden Caravan Rest — Warden caravan circle
svg.desc: Parked wagons ring a noncombat service court. Canvas roofs, stores and an observation mast provide an upper route while the aid convoy stays on broad ground. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.
svg.text: Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 36–40

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Parked wagons ring a noncombat service court. Canvas roofs, stores and an observation mast
provide an upper route while the aid convoy stays on broad ground.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Old Road Warden · Benevolent / Elite; aid / escort / protection, never a kill-farm target.
